entries.text: Cobalt Provisions registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the composition classification of each item to that item's registered product record.
Cobalt Trail Ration: a freeze-dried entree in a single-serve pouch. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor a composition classification.

Registered product terms. Intended use: backcountry trail meals on multi-day routes. Composition classification: the third-party audit for this ration has not been filed, so the registered composition classification is still pending.
